derivation: from H1334 (בָּתַר); (with the article) the craggy spot;
def: Bithron, a place East of the Jordan

occurrences.text: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain, and passed over Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and they came to Mahanaim.
